query: how the retrieval pipeline ranks results across channels

seed_memories.content: How the retrieval pipeline ranks results across channels: three channels (FTS5 BM25, HNSW vector, KG concept fanout) run in parallel, the ranked lists fuse with reciprocal rank fusion plus convex combination, and the top candidates are reranked by a multi-feature linear model that includes recency, access count, and canonical support.
seed_memories.summary: Retrieval pipeline ranks results across channels via parallel fusion and linear rerank.
